limitations: V1 is single-venue (Bybit); cross-venue aggregation is intentionally deferred.
Liquidation notional is estimated as size * bankruptcy price because the public allLiquidation feed reports bankruptcy price, not executed notional.
Absence of liquidation events is meaningful only while the liquidation websocket health is connected/OK.
Funding is a current context variable; settled funding history is not ingested in the live V1 loop.
The collector has no right to trade and is not yet consumed by Guardian production.
